00047 MIDIControllerInternal::MIDIControllerInternal(const int midiChannel, const int controllerNumber,
00048               const float minVal, const float maxVal,
00049               const ExternalControlSource::Warp warp, void* port) throw()
00050 : ExternalControlSourceInternal(minVal, maxVal, warp),
00051  midiChannel_(midiChannel),
00052  controllerNumber_(controllerNumber),
00053  port_(port)
00054 {
00055 }
00056 
00057 void MIDIControllerInternal::handleIncomingMidiMessage (MidiInput* source, const MidiMessage& message) throw()
00058 { 
00059  if(port_ != 0 && port_ != source)      return;
00060  if(message.isForChannel(midiChannel_) == false)   return;
00061  if(message.isController() == false)      return;
00062  if(message.getControllerNumber() != controllerNumber_) return;
00063  
00064  setNormalisedValue(message.getControllerValue() / 127.f);
00065 }
00066 
00067 MIDIController::MIDIController(const int midiChannel, const int controllerNumber,
00068           const float minVal, const float maxVal, 
00069           const ExternalControlSource::Warp warp, 
00070           void* port) throw()
00071 {
00072  internal = new MIDIControllerInternal(midiChannel, controllerNumber, minVal, maxVal, warp, port);
00073 }
